info.title: Open Exchange Rates API v0.7
info.description: Independently curated Open Exchange Rates v0.7 JSON REST contract covering all seven official read-only endpoints. Callers use their own App ID; subject to the terms, Hub does not proxy, cache, persist, or display responses.

appId.name: app_id
appId.description: Caller-owned Open Exchange Rates App ID. Never include it in examples, logs, or persistent storage.

ApiError.title: API error
ApiError.description: Common JSON object used by the supplier for error responses.

RateMap.title: Currency-rate map
RateMap.description: Dynamic object whose three-letter currency-code keys map to numeric rates.

additionalProperties.description: Rate of this currency relative to the response base.

StandardRatesResponse.title: Standard rates response
StandardRatesResponse.description: Rates envelope shared by the latest and historical endpoints.

base.description: Three-letter base currency used by the response.

CurrencyNamesResponse.title: Supported currencies response
CurrencyNamesResponse.description: Dynamic object mapping available three-letter currency codes to full currency names.

TimeSeriesRates.title: Rates by date
TimeSeriesRates.description: Dynamic object whose ISO-date keys map to rates for each date.

additionalProperties.description: Rate map for this UTC date.

TimeSeriesResponse.title: Time-series response
TimeSeriesResponse.description: Rates envelope returned by day for a requested date range.

start_date.description: First date in the result range.

end_date.description: Last date in the result range.

base.description: Three-letter base currency used by the response.

ConversionRequest.title: Conversion request echo
ConversionRequest.description: Conversion request parameters returned by the supplier.

query.description: Conversion path without the App ID.

ConversionMeta.title: Conversion metadata
ConversionMeta.description: Rate and time used by the supplier for the calculation.

timestamp.description: UTC Unix timestamp used for the calculation.

ConversionResponse.title: Currency conversion response
ConversionResponse.description: Supplier JSON response for a path-based currency conversion.

OhlcRate.title: OHLC rate
OhlcRate.description: Open, high, low, close, and average rates for one currency during the requested interval.

OhlcRates.title: OHLC rate map
OhlcRates.description: Dynamic object mapping currency codes to OHLC rate objects.

OhlcResponse.title: OHLC response
OhlcResponse.description: OHLC rates envelope for a requested start time and period.

start_time.description: UTC start of the result interval.

end_time.description: UTC end of the result interval.

base.description: Three-letter base currency used by the response.

rates.description: OHLC rates indexed by currency code.

PlanFeatures.title: Plan features
PlanFeatures.description: Availability flags for API features on the current plan.

base.description: Whether the base parameter is available.

symbols.description: Whether the symbols parameter is available.

UsagePlan.title: Plan information
UsagePlan.description: Supplier-plan summary associated with the App ID.

UsageStatistics.title: Usage statistics
UsageStatistics.description: Request statistics for the current billing period.

days_elapsed.description: Days elapsed in the current period.

days_remaining.description: Days remaining in the current period.

daily_average.description: Daily average requests for the current period.

UsageData.title: Usage data
UsageData.description: App ID, status, plan, and usage statistics.

app_id.description: Caller App ID; response-only and no real value may be stored or displayed.

UsageResponse.title: Usage response
UsageResponse.description: Successful response of the usage endpoint.
